items.answer: Nuclear can help some countries decarbonise, but cost and waste issues mean it is not right for every country.

items.stem: "Building motorways through wild areas could eventually cause new species to form." To what extent is this view justified?

items.answer: (a) throw number (0, 1, 2, … 10). (b) number of dice remaining (a six counts as “decayed” and is removed).
